pvLoopRoughness.description: Discrete approximation of integral(abs(d2P/dV2)) divided by integral(abs(dP/dV)) plus epsilon; exact implementation must be recorded by the verification script.

pressureHighFrequencyEnergy.description: Fraction of beat-aligned atrial pressure energy above the configured high-frequency band.

dPdtSpikeCount.description: Number of dP/dt spikes exceeding the configured robust threshold per beat.

aLoopAreaProxy.description: Area proxy for the booster-pump loop in atrial PV space.

vLoopAreaProxy.description: Area proxy for the reservoir/conduit loop in atrial PV space.

aOverVLoopRatio.description: A-loop area proxy divided by V-loop area proxy plus epsilon.

preloadStabilityIndex.description: Beat-to-beat stability of downstream ventricular preload under the atrial bridge candidate.

qDotClampHitFraction.description: Fraction of relevant valve-flow samples affected by qDot clamp/event surfaces.

rules: Preferred candidate should improve PV-loop roughness relative to negative control.
Preferred candidate should not worsen qDot/valve contamination relative to legacy comparator.
Fallback to legacy comparator is allowed only with owner acceptance and legacyComparator provenance.
Negative control cannot be selected by default if it exhibits jagged PV loops, pressure high-frequency energy, or preload instability.

notes: This target pack intentionally uses relative and sanity targets first. Absolute atrial clinical targets require a separate data audit.
Passing this pack does not validate atrial Land/RDQ, AF, atrial myopathy, or atrial calcium cycling.
